checkMessages: Escape command restores the current address.
Back/Forward/Up/current-document navigate independently of the workspace.
Actual list header sorting retains all files.
Flat filter matches the relative folder.
Invalid directory name creates no directory.
Duplicate directory is rejected without replacing the existing folder.
Create file is available after validating the disposable destination.
Q11 fixed: invalid file name leaves the dialog open with an error and creates no substitute file.
Correcting the name creates and opens the requested file.
Multiple local files enable batch and disable single rename.
Copy/Paste preserves source and identical destination bytes.
Successful Cut/Paste clears the application move intent.
Copy path writes the selected path to the disposable clipboard.
Conflict Skip has the expected destination result.
Conflict KeepBoth has the expected destination result.
Keep both creates a second free destination name.
Conflict Cancel has the expected destination result.
Conflict Replace has the expected destination result.
A real source sharing lock returns a transfer error and preserves the source.
Source bytes remain intact after failed copy.
Apply-to-all skips two conflicts with one dialog.
Cancel in real progress window stops the transfer and retains the copy source.
Drop accepts a local copy request.
Move command uses the isolated folder-picker destination.
One file does not offer batch rename.
Confirmed Escape cancels inline rename without touching disk.
Single rename updates current, pinned and recent paths.
Removing a favorite leaves its folder intact.
Batch order follows the visible list, independent of selection order.
Ranges/counter/regex groups/case produce the shown plan.
Batch apply updates actual files, current, pinned and recent paths.
Undo restores original names and all document links while window remains open.
Single rename without an explicit extension preserves extension, contents and separate display columns.
Detailed properties detects PNG from disposable bytes.
Both hash rows equal independently calculated known file hashes.
Property filter retains both hashes; full report includes filtered-out rows.
Copy full report uses all properties despite active filter.
Declining local deletion leaves the file intact.
Confirmed local deletion enters the actual Windows Recycle Bin without a sibling recovery folder.
Recovery button stays disabled after ordinary recycling.
Windows Recycle Bin restores the deleted bytes at the original path.
Recovery button enables for a stopped local journal.
Navigating to a folder without journals disables recovery.
Returning to a folder with a pending journal enables recovery.
Recovery restores interrupted operations and disables its button after journals are removed.
Pinned path remains correct after undo.
Start screen recent list shows the renamed path.
Remove recent entry preserves the physical file.
Every persistent store remains inside the disposable validation root.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: production file-manager commands, local disk pipelines, WPF folder/name/conflict/batch/details dialogs; isolated stores and disposable clipboard with prior data restored in memory
limitations: Local disposable files only. No physical gestures, shell Open With/Explorer/Windows properties launch, Android/MTP or installed-user migration. DropCommand is exercised; external file/folder pickers use the isolated demo destination. Cancellation at progress startup is live; mid-operation rollback/fault injection is covered by targeted tests.
